allowedSourceMaterial.overview: A cop who loses his partner in a shoot-out with gun smugglers goes on a mission to catch them. In order to get closer to the leaders of the ring he joins forces with an undercover cop who's working as a gangster hitman. They use all means of excessive force to find them.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: When a cop partners with an undercover agent posing as a mob hitman, can their volatile alliance take down the smuggling ring before their cover shatters?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: After his partner dies in a deadly shoot-out with gun smugglers, a grieving Hong Kong cop teams up with an undercover officer posing as a mob hitman, deploying relentless force to penetrate the syndicate's inner circle.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Fast-paced, suspenseful, and relentlessly exciting, this high-energy Hong Kong thriller demands engaged attention for explosive action nights.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Directed by John Woo, this fast-paced crime thriller channels kinetic shoot-outs and high-stakes tension into an electrifying, action-packed hunt through the criminal underworld.
